description: This file contains functions related to Drupal's locale translation management, including project list building, cache clearing, batch processing for translation status checks, and source file validation.

classes.name: ProjectInfo
classes.description: Utility class for processing project info list for modules and themes.

methods.name: locale_translation_flush_projects
methods.description: Clears all project data from the locale project service.

methods.name: locale_translation_build_projects
methods.description: Builds and stores a list of projects for translation, updating the database.

methods.name: locale_translation_project_list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of projects for translation, including custom interface projects.

methods.name: locale_translation_default_translation_server
methods.description: Gets default translation server pattern from configuration.

methods.name: locale_translation_check_projects
methods.description: Checks for updates in project translations, remotely or locally.

methods.name: locale_translation_check_projects_batch
methods.description: Initiates a batch process to check remote and local translation files.

methods.name: locale_translation_batch_status_build
methods.description: Builds a batch process for checking translation status.

methods.name: locale_translation_batch_status_finished
methods.description: Callback after batch process completion (not detailed in code).

methods.name: locale_translation_batch_version_check
methods.description: Checks version of translation files for a project and language.

methods.name: locale_translation_batch_status_check
methods.description: Checks status of translation files for a project and language.

methods.name: locale_translation_check_projects_local
methods.description: Checks local translation files for projects and languages.
